input.content:
You match an SEC filing to the finance research task it can best support.

You are given one filing of a U.S. public company and a list of task-tree leaves, each with the evidence modes (company scope, document scope, synthesis) it may be used in. A question writer will later write one expert question for the chosen leaf and mode, using this filing as a source together with other filings of the same company (and, for multi-company modes, one paired company).

Read the filing with `fetch_url` (the filing index page lists the exhibits, which you may also read). Choose the leaf and mode for which this filing supplies a substantive, specific input, such as figures, terms, or disclosures the analysis needs that a generic financial statement would not. Prefer a leaf where the filing is central over one where it is incidental. Answer "none" if no listed leaf fits.

Call `submit_match` once with the leaf id (or "none"), the mode, and a one- or two-sentence reason. If a submission is rejected as invalid, fix it and submit again.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its readable text content. Handles HTML and PDF. If `query` is provided, returns the top relevant paragraph chunks (BM25-ranked); otherwise returns the head of the page truncated to the token budget. SEC filings filed after this task's as-of date are refused.

query.description: Optional. If provided, return only the most relevant chunks of the page for this query rather than the head of the document.

max_tokens.description: Token budget for the returned content. Default 6000.

tools.name: submit_match
tools.description: Submit the leaf this filing best supports, or 'none', and end the session.

variant_mode.description: One of the modes listed for that leaf.
